Messages.Author: Chick Lewis
Messages.Body:
Some cards were removed from the Jyhad game system when
it was updated to VTES. Other cards were directly replaced
(camille>Raven) or renamed. The new cards are:

Rare(S?)
Protected Resources
Uncommons
Archon Investigation
Justicar Retribution
Shadow of the Beast
Common
Elder Intervention.

It seems to me the replacements must not be one-for one, since Rowan
Ring and Monocle of Clarity were both rares and are gone, and as far
as I know only PR is a new rare. Maybe it is a half-rare ? Also, in
the VTES boosters you always get 4 vampires, instead of sometimes
three vampires and one of the vampire rarity political cards in Jyhad
boosters. I wonder how WotC changed the layout of the sheets between
Jyhad and VTES. If anyone knows more, I would like to know.

Chick...@msn.com
